subject: Holiday pilot credit earmark + convert-to-dedicated discount?
messages:
From: Jessica Chen <jessica@winterlabs.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Holiday pilot credit earmark for Winter Labs cohort

Hi Aditya,

Quick note from Winter Labs — we run an accelerator cohort that kicks off Jan 10 and we had budgeted a small pilot with Redwood for a few founding teams. Given the timing, I wanted to ask whether you can earmark promotional pilot credits for the cohort and whether any year-end packaging exceptions are possible (we're evaluating capacity commitments post-pilot).

What we ideally need:
- $8k of usage credits earmarked to the Winter Labs cohort (applies across three companies in the cohort)
- The ability to convert up to 50% of unused credits into a credit toward a Dedicated reserved commit if a team converts within 90 days
- A short window for credit redemption (90 days) and a clear billing/escrow path so our finance team can account for it

Attached is a short note from our ops team on expected token volumes and a draft SOW. We like Redwood's performance numbers and want to make switching to Dedicated simple for teams that show traction.

Can you confirm feasibility and any constraints (tax/timing/legal) we should flag?

Thanks,
Jessica
Jessica Chen
Program Director, Winter Labs
jessica@winterlabs.ai
+1 415-555-0134

Attachment: winterlabs_promo_request.pdf
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Chen <jessica@winterlabs.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Holiday pilot credit earmark for Winter Labs cohort

Hi Jessica — thanks for the note and the SOW. We can support a year-end pilot earmark with a few guardrails so our billing and legal teams have a clear path. Proposed option below — happy to tweak based on your finance needs.

Proposal (pilot + convert path):
- Earmark $8,000 in pilot usage credits, split across the three cohort startups as you specify (we'll accept a roster file before Jan 8).
- Conversion option: if an individual startup signs a Dedicated reserved-commit within 90 days of credit activation, up to 50% of any remaining/unconsumed pilot credits may be applied toward their first-month Dedicated invoice as a one-time credit.
- Commitment sweetener: we can offer a 12% one-time conversion discount on the first 3 months of Dedicated billing if teams convert within 60 days (applies in lieu of standard onboarding fee waiver).
- Credits expire 90 days after activation; no cash payout.
- We will need a brief addendum to the standard SOW documenting the earmark and conversion mechanics — legal will prepare a short DocuSign.

Operational notes / ask for Winter Labs:
- Please send the final cohort roster by Jan 8 and indicate seat split (default equal split).
- Confirm whether any of the teams require an external invoicing entity / specific purchase order language.

I'm cc'ing Laura (Finance) and Ben (Programs) to confirm internal approval and to prepare the HubSpot deal and DocuSign. Attached is our pricing grid for visibility.

If that looks good I can get the addendum routed today so you have it before the holidays.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
+1 650-555-0190

Attachment: redwood_pricing_grid_Q4_v3.xlsx
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Winter Labs holiday earmark — finance + ops approval request

Laura / Ben — looping you in to get quick sign-off on the pilot + conversion carveout for Winter Labs. Key points below:

- Account: Winter Labs (accelerator program) — Deal RDW-D-2026-1157 (HubSpot link in metadata).
- Offer: $8k cohort pilot credits, 50% of unused credits eligible to convert to a first-month credit on Dedicated if conversion happens within 90 days. One-time 12% discount on first 3 months for conversions within 60 days.
- Why: accelerators are high-velocity switching events; the conversion path helps move teams to Dedicated without spinning up separate discount cycles.

Approvals / operational asks:
1) Laura: can Finance confirm the accounting treatment for the partial-credit-to-dedicated application? We need to be explicit for Winter Labs' CFO (they asked about escrow/billing treatment).
2) Ben: can Programs/Ops add an \"earmarked promo\" flag so Support/Billing won't auto-expire credits and so we can track redemption? Also need HubSpot deal updated and a DocuSign addendum template.

If both approve I will route the DocuSign and share the link with Winter Labs — they'd like the addendum before Dec 16.

Thanks — quick replies appreciated given the year-end calendar.

-Aditya

From: Jessica Chen <jessica@winterlabs.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: markus@winterlabs.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 09:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Holiday pilot credit earmark for Winter Labs cohort

Aditya — this looks great, thank you. Winter Labs accepts the proposed pilot earmark and the conversion mechanics. A few quick confirmations from our side:

- We'll send the roster by Jan 6 (some startups are still finalizing founders).
- Winter Labs will accept the 90-day expiry with the 50% conversion-cap as documented.
- Our finance team prefers the conversion credit to be reflected as a line-item credit on the first invoice (not as a retroactive refund) — that should be fine per your note but please confirm with Laura.

Please send the DocuSign addendum and I'll route internally so signatures are in place before Dec 20. Happy to loop Markus (ops) on the roster/process.

Thanks again — excited to run the cohort with Redwood.

Best,
Jessica
